steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-12, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-12, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-12, Survey Area T**

The VES interpretation at T-12 yields a 5-layer resistivity model. Resistivity decreases from Layer 1 (1228.3 Ω·m) to Layer 2 (678.3 Ω·m), then increases progressively through Layers 3, 4, and 5 (2104.5, 3417.4, and 3516.3 Ω·m respectively). Depths to layer base range from 0.41 m to 31.54 m, with Layer 5 extending to depth as the basal unit.

Applying the curve-type convention: Layers 1-2-3 (1228.3>678.3<2104.5) give H; Layers 2-3-4 (678.3<2104.5<3417.4) give A; Layers 3-4-5 (2104.5<3417.4<3516.3) give A. This yields HAA, consistent with the on-file classification.

No discrepancy was found between the computed curve type and the filed label. Drilling planning may proceed using the HAA curve-type designation as recorded.
